description: An agent-based, networked social-behavior simulation of mask adoption dynamics with social influence, policy mandates, information campaigns, mobility across locations, and market supply/price constraints.

modules.name: Initialization
modules.description: Create agents, locations, retailers, initial attributes, and schedules.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if day == 0:
  set RNG(seed=random_seed)
  create N=population_size persons with attributes sampled from distributions
  assign persons to households (mean size households_mean_size)
  assign persons to workplaces (mean size workplaces_mean_size)
  create public spaces count=public_spaces_count with capacities scaled by location_capacity_multiplier
  build schedules consistent with location_mix fractions
  initialize retailers_count retailers with inventory = initial_inventory_per_capita * population_size * mask_supply_level / retailers_count
  set retailer prices by base_mask_price and quality multipliers
  set policy.mandate_active = (0 if day < policy_start_day else 1)
  seed initial adopters: randomly select seed_adopters_fraction of persons to adopt if they can afford and inventory exists; else mark intent
notes: Runs fully on day 0; subsequent days perform only minimal checks for new entities (none).
Budgets are daily and sampled lognormally; trust and propensities sampled as Beta or truncated normal.

modules.name: NetworkBuilder
modules.description: Construct and maintain the social network between persons.

notes: Network is static post-initialization unless extended in experiments.
Ensure average_degree is even for Watts-Strogatz; adjust if needed.

modules.name: MobilityAndPresence
modules.description: Schedule daily attendance of persons at locations and record presence for enforcement and social observation.

notes: Capacity constraints can turn away excess demand.
Presence data feeds Enforcement and SocialLearning (peer observations in shared locations).

modules.name: PolicyAndCommunication
modules.description: Issue mandates, set enforcement intensity, and run information campaigns.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if day == policy_start_day:
  state.policy.mandate_active = 1
update state.policy.mandate_strictness = mandate_strictness
update state.policy.enforcement_probability = enforcement_probability
update state.policy.fine_amount = fine_amount
campaign_effect = info_campaign_intensity * exp(-communication_decay * max(0, day - policy_start_day)) if state.policy.mandate_active else 0
broadcast campaign_effect to persons (used to adjust awareness and risk perceptions in SocialLearning/AdoptionDecision)
adjust enforcement if violation_rate is high: state.policy.enforcement_probability = clip(enforcement_probability * (1 + 0.5*(violation_rate_daily - rolling_mean_violation)), 0, 1)
notes: Mandate targets location types via mandate_target_location_types.
Communication decay models diminishing returns of campaigns.

modules.name: Enforcement
modules.description: Check and enforce mask requirements at locations; apply fines and update violation counts.

notes: Perceived cost updated upon enforcement increases adoption pressure.
enforcement_record_window_days controls rolling stats used by PolicyAndCommunication.

modules.name: MarketAndRetail
modules.description: Retailers restock and adjust prices; persons purchase or replace masks given budgets and perceived need.

notes: Affordability threshold prevents purchases when budget is very constrained.
Replacement need sampled stochastically per agent around the mean interval.

modules.name: SocialLearning
modules.description: Agents observe peers and update beliefs about norms, benefits, risk, and awareness.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  # Peer observation in social network
  neighbor_mask_share = mean(mask_adoption_state of neighbors over last peer_observation_window_days) with observation_noise
  # Co-presence observation in locations (optional blend)
  copresent_mask_share = mean(mask_adoption_state of co-present agents in last peer_observation_window_days)
  perceived_norm = (neighbor_mask_share + copresent_mask_share)/2
  person.perceived_benefit = (1 - alpha_social_norm) * person.perceived_benefit + alpha_social_norm * (social_influence_weight * perceived_norm + perceived_prevalence_signal)
  # Campaign effect
  if state.policy.mandate_active:
    person.awareness_level += info_campaign_intensity * (1 - person.awareness_level)
    person.risk_perception = clip(person.risk_perception + 0.2*info_campaign_intensity*(1 - person.risk_perception), 0, 1)
  person.trust_in_authorities = clip(person.trust_in_authorities + 0.1*info_campaign_intensity*(1 - person.trust_in_authorities), 0, 1)
  # Decay if no mandate
  if not state.policy.mandate_active:
    person.awareness_level *= (1 - communication_decay)
    person.perceived_benefit *= (1 - communication_decay)
notes: Observation noise is Gaussian clipped to [0,1].
Beliefs updated via exponential smoothing controlled by alpha_social_norm.

modules.name: AdoptionDecision
modules.description: Compute adoption probability and update mask adoption state for each person.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  policy_pressure = state.policy.mandate_active * mandate_strictness * state.policy.enforcement_probability
  expected_penalty = policy_pressure * state.policy.fine_amount
  benefit_term = risk_perception_sensitivity * person.risk_perception + person.perceived_benefit + info_weight * person.awareness_level + trust_weight * person.trust_in_authorities
  cost_term = perceived_cost_sensitivity * person.perceived_cost + (base_mask_price * (1 if person.mask_quality_owned=='none' else 0))
  linear = logit(baseline_adoption_prob) + policy_weight * policy_pressure + mandate_penalty_salience * expected_penalty - cost_term + benefit_term
  p_adopt = sigmoid(linear + Normal(0, logit_noise_scale))
  # compliance decay
  person.compliance_propensity *= (1 - compliance_decay_rate)
  # Decision with budget and inventory effect handled in Market module via intent flag
  if rand() < p_adopt:
    person.intends_to_adopt = 1
  else:
    person.intends_to_adopt = 0
  # If already owns mask and intends_to_adopt, set wearing state = 1; else 0
  person.mask_adoption_state = 1 if (person.intends_to_adopt and person.mask_quality_owned!='none') else 0
observable.adoption_rate_daily = mean(person.mask_adoption_state over all persons)
notes: Adoption state requires both intent and access to a mask; Market module facilitates access.
Baseline adoption prob transformed via logit for linear specification.

modules.name: AnalyticsAggregator
modules.description: Aggregate daily observables and compute summary statistics.

update_rule.pseudocode:
observable.adoption_rate_daily = mean(person.mask_adoption_state)
for each location_type in {household, workplace, public_space}:
  compute mean mask usage among attendees of that type => observable.compliance_by_location_type.*
observable.violation_rate_daily = len(state.enforcement_actions_today) / max(number_of_checks_today,1)
observable.average_mask_quality_daily = mean(quality_numeric(person.mask_quality_owned) weighted by person.mask_adoption_state)
compute budget quintiles; for each quintile, adoption_by_budget_quintile_daily[q] = mean(mask_adoption_state of persons in quintile q)
observable.price_daily = mean(current retailer average price across qualities weighted by sales)
observable.purchases_daily = total purchases today
notes: Checks count equals number of required entries considered in Enforcement.

algorithms.SmallWorldNetwork: Watts-Strogatz network generation with N, k, p.
algorithms.BeliefUpdateSmoothing: Exponential smoothing for perceived benefit and norms with alpha_social_norm.
algorithms.LogitAdoption: Logistic function for adoption probability with linear utility and noise.
algorithms.PriceAdjustment: Elastic price update based on demand-supply imbalance.
algorithms.WindowedDifference: Pre/post window average difference to estimate mandate effect.
